## Summary

I've successfully implemented the OnboardingStyle page redesign to match the design specifications. Here's what was completed:

### Changes Made:
- **Fixed card height inconsistency**: Changed from flexible height (`h-auto min-h-[96px]`) to fixed height (`h-[320px]`) for uniform card sizing
- **Updated image container**: Changed from `aspect-[3/4]` with `h-[120%]` overflow hack to fixed `h-[220px]` (~70% of card) with proper `object-cover object-top` positioning
- **Fixed text content section**: Changed to fixed `h-[100px]` (~30% of card) with `flex-shrink-0` to prevent variable heights
- **Added text truncation**: Applied `line-clamp-3` class to `cardDescription` to handle varying description lengths
- **Added flex layout**: Applied `flex flex-col` to the button card container for proper layout structure
- **Added CSS utilities**: Created `.style-card`, `.style-card-image`, `.style-card-content` utility classes and `.line-clamp-2`/`.line-clamp-3` text truncation utilities in globals.css
- **Border colors preserved**: Kept consistent border color variables (`--onboarding-card-border: #E8D5D5` for unselected, `--onboarding-card-border-selected: #D4B5B5` for selected)

### Files Changed:
```
 app/globals.css                           | 257 +++++++++++++++++++++++++-----
 components/onboarding/OnboardingStyle.tsx | 153 ++++++++----------
 2 files changed, 282 insertions(+), 128 deletions(-)
```

### Validation:
- Build completed successfully with no TypeScript errors
- All existing lint warnings are pre-existing (not introduced by this change)
